intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按公共安全故事线跟读：Jimmy Gates 决定把 presents 送到 children's hospital；他 dressed up as Father Christmas 并骑 Jumbo 上 main street；警察指出 he should have known 和 ought to have gone along a side street；Jumbo refused to move；最后用 must weigh、fortunate、didn't have to carry 和 let him off 读出轻松的警察玩笑。

sentences.text: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：去年圣诞节，马戏团老板 Jimmy Gates 决定给儿童医院送礼物。注意 Last Christmas 后轻停，decided to take ... to ... 说明目的和去向。

sentences.text: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他打扮成 Father Christmas，在仪仗队陪同下骑着 Jumbo 沿主街出发。长句先读 Dressed up as... and accompanied by...，再进入 he set off down...。
focus_words: set off down the main street

sentences.text: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他本该知道警察不会允许这种事。Should have known 是事后判断，读出“本该想到”的语气。

sentences.text: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：警察走近 Jimmy，告诉他本该走 side street，因为 Jumbo 正在挡交通。Approached 和 ought to have gone 要读清楚，holding up the traffic 是核心短语。

sentences.text: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：虽然 Jimmy 同意马上走，Jumbo 却拒绝移动。Though 开头先让步，refused to move 读出喜剧转折。

sentences.text: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：十五个警察不得不用力把它推离主街。Fifteen policemen 开头要稳，had to push very hard 表示费力，to get him off 是目的。

sentences.text: Jumbo must weigh a few tons, said a policeman afterwards, so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：Jumbo 一定有好几吨重，幸好警察不用把它抬走。Must 是根据证据的强判断；fortunate 和 didn't have to carry him 读出轻松的玩笑。

sentences.text: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：当然我们应该逮捕它，但因为它记录良好，这次就放过它。读 final quote 时带一点轻松幽默，let him off this time 是笑点。
